title: Signature-Preserving Retry Decorators (Sync and Async)
instructions: Implement the `retry` and `aretry` decorator factories in `retry.py` using PEP 695 `[**P, R]` syntax and `functools.wraps`. They retry matching exceptions with `base_delay * 2 ** (attempt - 1)` backoff through an injectable `sleep`, and `attempts < 1` raises `ValueError`. The strict type-check part (`mypy --strict` / pyright, keeping the exact signature) is self-checked; the hidden tests grade runtime behaviour only.

evidence.label: Retries then succeeds, sleeping base_delay * 2**(n-1) between attempts
Re-raises the last error after the final attempt without sleeping again
Exceptions not matching `on` propagate after a single call
`on` accepts a tuple of exception types
attempts < 1 raises ValueError("attempts must be >= 1") from both factories
The default sync sleep does not really wait
aretry awaits the function and the injected sleep with the same schedule
aretry gives up after the last attempt and does not retry unmatched errors
